meta.title: Taylor Crouch | Full-stack Web Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Taylor Crouch, a Tokyo-based full-stack web developer building multilingual web applications.

top.subtitle: Tokyo-based developer building multilingual products across frontend, backend, and client delivery.
top.summary: I build and ship web applications across TypeScript/React/Next.js and Vue.js, WordPress/PHP, Go (Gin), and Java stacks. Recent work emphasizes leading small teams, working with clients on scope and technical solutions, and operating multilingual sites and platforms in production environments. English native; Japanese JLPT N3.

experience.intro: Technical delivery spans internal tools and client-facing products. Earlier roles emphasize teaching, research, and cross-functional collaboration in education settings.

roles.title: Full-stack Web Developer
highlights: Led teams of 2–5 developers in delivering internal and client-facing web applications.
Worked directly with clients to define requirements, technical solutions, project scope, and schedules.
Developed and maintained applications across WordPress/PHP, Vue.js front ends, Go services, and Java monolith architectures.
Supported multilingual corporate sites, internal tools, and client-facing platforms across multiple environments.

roles.title: Volunteer Web Developer
highlights: Fixed UI/UX issues and improved responsive behavior across devices.
Supported localization improvements for a multilingual user experience.
Added Cypress end-to-end test coverage and contributed to Django backend updates.
Collaborated remotely with a cross-functional team of 10–15 members.

roles.title: Assistant Language Teacher
highlights: Collaborated with teachers to plan and deliver classes for 30+ students.
Supported curriculum and assessment preparation with a focus on clarity and accuracy.

roles.title: Research Assistant in Physics Education
highlights: Analyzed research data and presented findings at academic conferences.

roles.title: Teaching Assistant for General Physics Labs
highlights: Supported course delivery and instructed students in general physics labs.

entries.credential: B.S. in Physics; minors in Business Administration and English

mediaLibraryManager.name: Media Library Manager
mediaLibraryManager.description: Built a self-hosted application for cataloging movies, TV, music, books, and games, with secure authentication, external metadata integration, and barcode-assisted lookup for physical media.
highlights: Catalog movies, TV, music, books, and games with secure, user-scoped access.
Integrate external metadata and barcode-assisted lookup for faster cataloging of physical media.
Operate as a self-hosted stack with REST APIs and S3-compatible object storage.
Modern front end with TypeScript, SCSS, and Vite paired with Go (Gin) services.
